content:
Footer

Configure footer text that appears at the bottom of sales quotes.

Use footers to add terms, conditions, or additional information to sales quotes.

Name

Enter a name to identify this footer. This name will appear in dropdown menus when selecting a footer for sales quotes.

Content

Enter the content that will appear at the bottom of sales quotes. You can include quote validity, terms, disclaimers, or any other important information.

Inactive

Mark this footer as inactive to prevent it from appearing in footer selection dropdowns. Existing sales quotes using this footer will not be affected.
